provenance: Transcribed from BUG-022 scopes.md during atomic packet filing. All carriers are planned and no execution or certification is claimed.

scenarios.title: Historical report receipt is non-declarative

gherkin.given: a report.md receipt containing node --test tests/portfolio-*.mjs and a Playwright spec matcher
gherkin.then: the report contributes no Node declaration and creates no portfolio crossing

scenarios.coverageNote: Carrier must be authored and executed by the test owner.

scenarios.title: Active broad Node declaration still crosses

gherkin.given: an active command authority containing node --test tests/portfolio-*.mjs and a Playwright spec matcher
gherkin.then: the active artifact and line are retained and portfolio specs are exposed as crossings

scenarios.coverageNote: Adversarial carrier must prove the invariant was not weakened.

scenarios.title: Legitimate Node families have current authority

gherkin.given: active commands for tests/*.functional.mjs and tests/*.test.mjs
gherkin.then: both families remain reachable without report receipts and the baseline does not grow

scenarios.coverageNote: Reachability and selftest executions are required.

scenarios.title: Historical Feature 008 evidence remains immutable

gherkin.given: the Feature 008 BUG-004 report at the filing commit
gherkin.then: the captured portfolio command, outcome, and sha256 remain byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.coverageNote: A path-limited Git comparison is required.
